headline: Google may use your personal data for targeted ads
standfirst: A recent privacy policy update suggests your private files could soon influence the ads

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Google updated its privacy policy to allow ad targeting based on your personal data.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The change creates an exception for users who engage with new personalized AI features.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Your Gmail, Drive, and Photos data could now be used to tailor the ads you see online.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on how these AI features roll out and if user privacy settings change.

caption:
Google is updating its privacy policy regarding how it uses your data for targeted advertising.

The tech giant is carving out new exceptions for its AI tools. This means your private files might soon play a role in the ads shown to you. The changes were spotted by tech outlets reviewing the latest policy updates.

Are you comfortable sharing your personal data if it makes AI tools more helpful?
